infoPlist.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Allow NurAI to play your selected Athan at prayer time, even when Silent Mode or Focus is on.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NurAI uses your location while you use the app to calculate prayer times, show Qibla direction, and find nearby mosques.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NurAI uses your camera to scan QR codes, boarding pass barcodes, and to share content.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NurAI lets you choose a private profile photo and share Islamic content when you ask.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: NurAI may save shareable Islamic content or health reflection cards when you choose to export them.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: NurAI uses Face ID to protect your privacy and secure app access.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: NurAI reads selected Apple Health data, such as steps, sleep, heart rate, workouts, active energy, and mindful minutes, only with your permission to build gentle Muslim self-care reminders.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: NurAI writes selected wellbeing actions only when you explicitly allow it, such as mindful minutes or workout-related self-care records.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: NurAI reads selected Apple Health data, such as steps, sleep, heart rate, workouts, active energy, and mindful minutes, only with your permission to build gentle Muslim self-care reminders.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: NurAI writes selected wellbeing actions only when you explicitly allow it, such as mindful minutes or workout-related self-care records.

plugins.photosPermission: NurAI lets you choose a private profile photo or a meal photo when you ask.
plugins.cameraPermission: NurAI uses your camera to scan a meal and estimate dish, ingredients, and calories.
